name: strad-server-pointsyeah
description: PointsYeah MCP server packaged as a strad supplementary-image bundle (streamable-HTTP over the shared/ tool logic).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace remote

comments.overrides: Pin Playwright to the exact version whose bundled Chromium (rev 1228) ships in the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble base image, so the container never has to download a browser at build time. shared/ declares ^1.58.2 and remote/ ^1.58.2; 1.61.1 satisfies both while guaranteeing the runtime matches the image.
